description.sr:
Napiši funkciju `isPalindrome(text)` koja vraća `true` ako se tekst isto čita sa obe strane.

Velika i mala slova se ne razlikuju, a razmaci i znaci interpunkcije se ignorišu (računaju se samo slova a-z i cifre).

Primeri:
- `isPalindrome('level')` → `true`
- `isPalindrome('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama')` → `true`
- `isPalindrome('hello')` → `false`
description.en:
Write a function `isPalindrome(text)` that returns `true` if the text reads the same from both ends.

Letter case does not matter, and spaces and punctuation are ignored (only the letters a-z and digits count).

Examples:
- `isPalindrome('level')` → `true`
- `isPalindrome('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama')` → `true`
- `isPalindrome('hello')` → `false`

label.en: clean, then compare with the reverse

text.sr:
Ovde pravimo (deklarišemo) funkciju. Funkcija je imenovan komad koda koji možemo da pozovemo koliko god puta hoćemo, svaki put sa drugim ulazom.

- `function isPalindrome` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom. Test je poziva baš tim imenom, pa mora biti napisano tačno ovako (velika i mala slova se razlikuju).
- `(text)` je lista parametara. Parametar je prazno „mesto“ za ulaz: kad pozovemo `isPalindrome('level')`, unutar funkcije je `text` jednako `'level'`.
- `{` otvara telo funkcije, a zatvara ga `}` u liniji 4.

Sama deklaracija ništa ne računa. Kod iz tela se izvršava tek kad funkciju pozovemo.
text.en:
Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function isPalindrome` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(text)` is the parameter list. A parameter is an empty “slot” for input: when we call `isPalindrome('level')`, inside the function `text` equals `'level'`.
- `{` opens the function body, and `}` on line 4 closes it.

The declaration itself computes nothing. The code in the body runs only when we call the function.

text.sr:
Pravimo „očišćenu“ verziju teksta: sve malim slovima, bez razmaka i interpunkcije.

- `const cleaned` pravi promenljivu koja se ne dodeljuje ponovo.
- `text.toLowerCase()` pretvara sva slova u mala, pa `A` i `a` postaju ista stvar. Stringovi su nepromenljivi, pa dobijamo novi string.
- `.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')` zamenjuje delove teksta koji odgovaraju šablonu. Šablon `/[^a-z0-9]/g` je regularni izraz: `[ ]` je skup znakova, `a-z` i `0-9` su opsezi (slova i cifre), a `^` na početku skupa znači „sve osim“. Dakle, „bilo koji znak koji NIJE malo slovo ili cifra“.
- `g` na kraju znači „globalno“: zameni sve pojave, ne samo prvu.
- `''` je zamena: prazan string, tj. te znakove brišemo.
- Redosled je bitan: prvo `toLowerCase`, pa onda `replace`. Da je obrnuto, velika slova bi bila obrisana jer nisu u opsegu `a-z`.
- Ograničenje: slova van engleske abecede (č, š, ž) se brišu, jer nisu u `a-z`.

Primer:

```
'A man, a plan' → toLowerCase → 'a man, a plan'
               → replace      → 'amanaplan'
```
text.en:
We build a “cleaned” version of the text: all lowercase, without spaces and punctuation.

- `const cleaned` creates a variable that is not reassigned.
- `text.toLowerCase()` converts all letters to lowercase, so `A` and `a` become the same thing. Strings are immutable, so we get a new string.
- `.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')` replaces the parts of the text that match the pattern. The pattern `/[^a-z0-9]/g` is a regular expression: `[ ]` is a set of characters, `a-z` and `0-9` are ranges (letters and digits), and `^` at the start of the set means “anything except”. So, “any character that is NOT a lowercase letter or a digit”.
- `g` at the end means “global”: replace all occurrences, not just the first.
- `''` is the replacement: an empty string, i.e. we delete those characters.
- The order matters: first `toLowerCase`, then `replace`. The other way round, capital letters would be deleted because they are not in the range `a-z`.
- Limitation: letters outside the English alphabet (č, š, ž) are deleted, because they are not in `a-z`.

Example:

```
'A man, a plan' → toLowerCase → 'a man, a plan'
               → replace      → 'amanaplan'
```

text.sr:
Poredimo očišćeni tekst sa njegovom obrnutom verzijom.

- `[...cleaned].reverse().join('')` pravi obrnuti string: spread rastavlja na znakove, `reverse` okreće redosled, `join('')` spaja nazad (isto kao u zadatku „Obrni string“).
- `===` poredi dva stringa po vrednosti i vraća `true` ili `false`. Taj rezultat se direktno vraća, pa nije potreban `if`.
- Za prazan tekst je `cleaned` jednako `''`, a `'' === ''` je `true`, što test traži.

```
cleaned = 'amanaplanacanalpanama'
obrnuto = 'amanaplanacanalpanama'   → true

cleaned = 'hello'
obrnuto = 'olleh'                   → false
```
text.en:
We compare the cleaned text with its reversed version.

- `[...cleaned].reverse().join('')` builds the reversed string: spread splits into characters, `reverse` reverses the order, `join('')` joins back (the same as in the “Reverse a string” exercise).
- `===` compares two strings by value and returns `true` or `false`. That result is returned directly, so no `if` is needed.
- For empty text `cleaned` is `''`, and `'' === ''` is `true`, which the test requires.

```
cleaned = 'amanaplanacanalpanama'
reversed = 'amanaplanacanalpanama'  → true

cleaned = 'hello'
reversed = 'olleh'                  → false
```

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: Prvo se tekst normalizuje (mala slova, bez znakova), pa se poredi sa svojom obrnutom verzijom.
note.en: The text is normalized first (lowercase, no symbols), then compared with its own reversed version.
